source_issue.title: siteTitleFormat.titleAndSiteTitleSeparator is ignored: ContentMetadataTags reads the wrong settings key

summary_markdown:
```markdown
## What this issue is about
This issue is about a bug in the Volto project where a custom separator for the page title and site title is ignored. Instead of using the specified separator, it defaults to using a dash (`-`). The incorrect key is being read from the configuration settings.

## What needs to be done
The goal is to modify the `ContentMetadataTags.jsx` component to read the separator from `config?.settings?.siteTitleFormat?.titleAndSiteTitleSeparator`, while keeping the top-level key as a fallback. This will ensure that the correct separator is used as documented.

## Helpful background
The separator is intended to be defined in the configuration under `siteTitleFormat`, where it can be customized. For example, it can be set to `|` instead of the default `-`. The issue was originally identified while triaging another ticket.

## Good first steps
1. Clone the repository and navigate to the `ContentMetadataTags.jsx` file in `packages/volto/src/components/theme/ContentMetadataTags/`.
2. Update the code to read the separator from the correct configuration path.
3. Ensure to implement a test case that verifies the custom separator works as expected.
4. Consider adding a news entry to document this change.
5. After making changes, submit your pull request for review!
```
